name: telegramshopweb
start: if ! sudo docker info >/dev/null 2>&1; then setsid sudo dockerd </dev/null >/tmp/dockerd.log 2>&1 & fi; for i in $(seq 1 30); do sudo docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; sleep 1; done; sudo chmod 666 /var/run/docker.sock 2>/dev/null || true; sudo docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo '[start] docker ready' || echo '[start] docker NOT ready'
